corrections.reason: The old figure had no source and disagrees with NIHORT's ugu production guide.

corrections.old: leave 30 cm of stem when cutting
corrections.new: cut about 5 cm above a node
corrections.reason: Leaving 30 cm removes most of the regrowing stem and is not what NIHORT recommends.

corrections.old: 1 m x 1 m for leaves; 2 m x 1 m for seed
corrections.new: 1 m x 1 m rainfed (10,000 plants/ha); 0.5 m x 0.3 m dry season (65,000 plants/ha)
corrections.reason: The seed-production spacing was unsourced; the dry-season system was missing entirely.

corrections.old: NPK 15:15:15 at 200 kg/ha plus urea after each cutting
corrections.new: 20 t/ha poultry manure, or 25-50% pre-plant plus split NPK; 80-90 kg N/ha split
corrections.reason: Replaced an unsourced blanket rate with NIHORT's per-hectare recommendation and a scaling caveat.
